items.note: SPDF conformance document: seven transmissions transcribed literally from NASA's Apollo 11 Technical Air-to-Ground Voice Transcription (Manned Spacecraft Center, Houston, 1969). Times are ground elapsed time (GET) in seconds, as in the transcription; each span ends at the next later transmission. The recording itself is not included and source_sha256 is a placeholder; word timings are spread evenly over each span, not measured.
